top_signals.title: Robert Hall and Michael Woodford win 2026 Nobel economics prize
top_signals.summary: The award, formally known as the Sveriges Riksbank Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel, was the final prize to be given this year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Investment firms of ultra-wealthy families aren't immune to FOMO.

top_signals.title: Nobel Prize in Economics Shared by Hall, Woodford
top_signals.summary: US-based academics Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford will share the 2026 Nobel Prize in Economics for their work on the "microeconomic foundations of macroeconomic stabilization," according to the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences in Stockholm. (Source: Associated Press)
